events.title: Meet Anastasia
events.venue: Cyprus House, 4 Vulture Street, West End
events.blurb: Welcome Anastasia to Brisbane before Friday’s concert. Join GOYA and Brisbane’s Greek and Cypriot associations at Cyprus House for a meet-and-greet on Thursday 1 October, from 5pm to 7pm.
events.entryNote: See the official announcement for the latest event information.
See the organiser’s announcement for booking enquiries. A start time and direct ticket link have not been verified.
events.title: Anastasia Concert
events.blurb: Anastasia performs live in Brisbane on Friday 2 October at The Greek Club, opening the GOYA Weekend. Follow GOYA Brisbane for the latest start time and ticket details.

events.entryNote: Gates open at 11:30am. Matches begin at noon; the grand final is scheduled for 7pm, followed by trophy presentations at 7:50pm.
events.title: Aegean Cup
events.blurb: Our weekend football comp, run with the Kos community of Brisbane — 8 teams representing the Greek islands, 2 groups, 1 champion. Teams, trophies and plenty of filotimo. Interstate parea, this one is well worth the trip. Follow @aegeancup for the draw and updates.

events.entryNote: 18+ only. See the official announcement for the latest entry information.
events.title: Aegean Cup After Party
events.blurb: The Aegean Cup continues after the final whistle. Join the parea for the Aegean Cup After Party on Saturday 3 October. Head to Olympic FC Function Hall from 9pm for a night with Brisbane’s Greek community. This event is strictly 18+.

stories.title: Meet the people making it happen.
stories.summary: The 2026 committee brings together six teams: events, socials, sport, Junior GOYA, faith and culture, and GOYA House.
stories.body: GOYA’s 2026 committee announcement sets out a focus on connecting young Greek Australians in Brisbane. Six subcommittees share the work, from welcoming people to events to caring for the house and planning activities for the next generation.

stories.title: A little team spirit.
stories.summary: GOYA’s netball team took to the UQ courts, with the community invited to cheer them on.
stories.body: On 7 September, GOYA invited friends and supporters to UQ Netball Courts for the team’s 7pm game. The activity has now finished, but the invitation says something simple about GOYA: there is room to play, support and belong.
